translations.web: He asked him, “What is your name?” He said to him, “My name is Legion, for we are many.”
translations.bsb: “What is your name?” Jesus asked. “My name is Legion,” he replied, “for we are many.”
translations.kjv: And he asked him, What is thy name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.
translations.asv: And he asked him, What is thy name? And he saith unto him, My name is Legion; for we are many.
